Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary The game starts with the first player taking their turn, followed by alternating turns between players. On their turn, a player must choose one of the following actions to perform: Place a piece : Move one of their off-board pieces onto an empty space on the board. Move a piece : Move an existing piece on the board according to the game's movement rules. Dice Movement Rules: Select Your Top Die: Choose one stack where your die is on top. Lift the Stack: Pick up all dice from that stack while maintaining their current order. Determine Movement: The number of dice in hand equals the exact number of spaces you must move. Execute Movement: Players may only move to empty spaces or spaces holding 1-2 dice At each new space, place the bottommost die from your hand. But you can't do it when that die is smaller than the top die in the space (specially, 6 is smaller than 1 here ) Continue until all dice are placed Key Points: You must move the exact number of spaces equal to the dice you picked up Dice are always placed from the bottom of your hand upward Each move must land on a new, unvisited space during your turn Obtaining Dragon Son Cards: One of the card's spaces must contain a stack of 3 dice Important: Yellow cards require fulfilling additional conditions specified on the card itself to be obtained Important:Acquiring red cards may trigger negative side effects Game End Conditions: The game ends when either of the following conditions is met: There are only 4 cards left on the board. A player reaches 7 points first.
